map.均值对极端值敏感，中位数不受极值影响；舆情打分无异常极端值时两者接近（如此例均=: The mean is sensitive to outliers while the median is not affected by extreme values. When sentiment scores contain no extreme outliers the two are close (here mean = median = 3.5) and the mean can be used directly; if there are rating-brigade or spam outliers, rely on the median instead.
map.标准差到底代表什么？: What does the standard deviation really mean?
map.标准差衡量打分的离散/分化程度，越大说明评价越两极（口碑分化），越小说明意见越一: The standard deviation measures how spread out the scores are: the larger it is, the more polarized the ratings; the smaller it is, the more consistent the opinions. The range shows the span between the two ends, the standard deviation shows the overall spread, and the two complement each other.
